why: phase-427 W9 (2026-09-07) — LANDED. `ContextSource::Baked` (`packages/api/nros/src/init.rs:173`): the `source` a `Context` built by `Context::baked()` reports — and therefore what `default_from_env()` / `from_env()` report on a freestanding build, where "the environment" is the one this image was compiled for. Diagnostics and tests only, like its siblings `Env` and `Launch` (`rust:ContextSource`); no upstream counterpart because rclrs has nothing baked.
